# Breathe Woods

> Breathe Woods is a private six-and-a-half-acre nature retreat in Raigad, Maharashtra, with two private villas, rain-fed water, gardens, trails, and home-style meals.

- Contact: https://www.breathewoods.com/contact.html

## Verified business facts

- Location: Kakadshet Road, Off Tala–Indapur Road, Muthavli Village, Indapur, Raigad, Maharashtra 402120, India.
- Contact: +91 99677 86444 · breathewoods@gmail.com.
- Accommodation: two private villas and five bedrooms in total.
- Meals: breakfast is included with every stay; By the Bruk serves meals on the property.
- Pets: pet-friendly stays are available; guests should confirm practical details before arrival.
- Travel context: approximately 2.5–3 hours from Mumbai and Pune, depending on traffic and road conditions.
- Directions: use live Google Maps navigation for final route and current road conditions.
